The plant-based side of Liberty Ave

On Liberty Avenue — the heart of Little Guyana — Veggie Castle sits a few doors from Sybil’s Bakery, the beloved Guyanese institution, and food writers have long reported what regulars already know: the same family runs both, and the Castle is the all-plants side of the family table.

So the pepperpot-style stews, curries, callaloo and roti of a Guyanese kitchen get cooked the ital way — soy chick’n, jackfruit, oyster mushrooms and garden vegetables seasoned like somebody’s grandmother is watching. Because one probably is.

Next to the steam table, the juice bar presses blends named for what they’re for — Eyes, Allergies, Skin Tight — and folds Irish sea moss into smoothies the way Liberty Ave has done it for years.

“Best vegan West Indian food in the city.”
— From the Google reviews
